green baseline. Plan:
[20260805-002629_tier1-tier2-features.plan.qmd](./20260805-002629_tier1-tier2-features.plan.qmd).

|---|--------|-------|
| 0 | `6a49600 chore: type-check src+tests and fix pre-existing lint/type drift` | baseline (added) |

# What was built

- **Tier 1 — `qc-summary`.** A fourth subcommand: one Parquet row per BAM-header
  reference joining FL, TC, AP, and per-base error counts/rate. `--config` is
  **optional** (FL + `total_reads` always compute; TC/AP/error populate only
  with config). Reuses the shared `processing.py` functions + `ErrorStatsCollector`
  for the error tally — no logic duplication. Output columns: `seq_name,
  total_reads, fl, fl_pct, on_target, on_target_pct, ap_Both, ap_StartOnly,
  ap_EndOnly, ap_Neither, mismatches, insertions, deletions, aligned_bases,
  error_rate`. Zero-read refs appear with zeros.
- **Tier 2a — cs pre-flight warning.** `_CsWatch` counts mapped reads lacking a
  `cs` tag; warns once early (≥1000 reads, >50% missing) plus a final summary.
  Warn-only, gated on whether a cs-dependent feature is active; wired into all
  four orchestrators.
- **Tier 2b — CRAM/SAM I/O.** `_open_reader` auto-detects BAM/CRAM/SAM for file
  inputs; `_open_writer(output, header, fmt, fasta)`; `annotate --output-format
  bam|cram|sam` (CRAM requires `--fasta`, fail-fast). cyclopts validates the
  `Literal` choice (probed first).
- **Tier 2c — library API.** `sam_tagger.__all__` re-exports the 4 orchestrators,
  4 Args dataclasses, 4 collectors, and `load_config`.

# Verification (evidence)

Commands run before every stage commit, all green:

```bash
pixi run -e dev test       # 126 passed (105 baseline + 21 new)
pixi run -e dev lint       # ruff check . — All checks passed!
pixi run -e dev typecheck  # pyright — 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 informations
```

New tests: `test_qc_summary.py` (6: multi-ref + zero-read ref, all 4 AP
statuses, no-config, error cross-check vs `error-stats`, empty BAM, CLI
dispatch), `test_cs_warning.py` (7: `_CsWatch` threshold/frac/disabled/silent +
orchestrator wiring), `test_cram.py` (6: CRAM round-trip, auto-detect read, SAM
output, BAM default, cram-without-fasta raises, invalid format rejected),
`test_public_api.py` (2).

Behavioural checks:

- `sam-tagger --help` lists **four** subcommands; `qc-summary --help` shows
  `-i/-o/--config` (`--config` optional).
- `qc-summary` error columns match a hand-join of `error-stats` per_base on the
  same BAM (`test_qc_summary_error_matches_error_stats`).
- A no-cs BAM triggers exactly one summary warning through `qc-summary` and
  `annotate --add-ee`; `annotate --add-fl` alone stays silent.
- `annotate --output-format cram --fasta ref.fa` writes a CRAM whose `FL` tag
  survives re-reading (this env's htslib supports CRAM write — all CRAM tests
  run, none skipped).
- `from sam_tagger import run_annotate, AnnotateArgs` works (`test_public_api`).

# Deviations from plan (and why)

- **Baseline cleanup (`6a49600`) added.** The plan assumed the `pixi run -e dev`
  gate was green; it was not — `typecheck` (pyright, no path arg) had 34
  pre-existing errors and `lint` had 1, because prior work measured narrower
  scopes. Codified `[tool.pyright] include=["src","tests"] exclude=["scripts"]`
  and fixed 8 real test type errors + 1 lint (`l` → `line`).
- **`ErrorStatsCollector._write_*` take a `paths` param.** Making `paths`
  Optional triggered `reportOptionalMemberAccess` in the 7 writers; passing a
  narrowed local (not 7 asserts) is the type-clean fix. `write_results` raises
  if `paths is None` (fail-loud).
- **`_HasCsTag` Protocol** added so `_CsWatch.observe` is unit-testable with a
  fake record (and still accepts `pysam.AlignedSegment`).
- **Stage 1 `run_qc_summary` shipped without `_CsWatch`**; stage 2 retro-fit it
  into all four orchestrators, exactly as the staged plan specified.

# Out of scope (unchanged)

snakeforge-templates embedding, CI workflow, GitHub remote — separate follow-ups.
